verdict.rationale: turbopuffer documents native BM25 full-text search on string and []string attributes, positions itself as a combined 'vector and full-text search' engine, and adds trigram regex indexes and server-side RRF fusion, so keyword search runs inside the database without a separate engine. missing for 10: detailed FTS documentation (tokenizers, language/stemming, phrase or fuzzy support), independent or hands-on corroboration of full-text search quality.
